verdict.rationale: Wave runs a live public GraphQL endpoint, which an unauthenticated introspection probe confirmed. However, no evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The developer portal returned 403 and could not be crawled, and Wave's marketing pages document no API surface, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
